title: ReclassifyTopicTests - triage-time correction of a topic's classification (FR-164 / DW-032 / WBS-23.4). Seven handler and validator cases: the command's role gate is Chairman + Secretary; a pre-Accept correction changes both fields and emits Topics.TopicReclassified; a correction that changes NOTHING writes no audit row; a no-op on a topic past Triage is accepted rather than refused, because the no-op check runs before the domain call; a real correction past Triage is refused BY THE AGGREGATE and writes no audit row; an unknown topic is a KeyNotFound rather than a silent success; and the validator refuses an undefined enum value on either field. Each guard is mutation-proven with a COMPILING mutant: dropping the no-op early return kills exactly the two no-op cases. THE REACHABILITY GUARD IS PART OF THIS ROW: Topic::Reclassify/2 came OUT of the AggregateReachabilityTests allowlist, and removing it is the deliverable - a mutant that makes the handler stop calling Reclassify compiles and turns that suite red. SPA side: four TopicDetail cases (the control is offered pre-Accept and not past it, not to a member, the current type is excluded from the choices, and the topic's existing source is carried unchanged) plus one hook case asserting the POST body and cache invalidation. The source assertion was itself mutation-proven and FAILED the first time - the fixture's source matched the literal a hardcoding mutant would use, so it was changed to a value nothing else produces.
custom_attributes: {"covers": "FR-164", "projects": ["Acmp.Application.Tests", "Acmp.Architecture.Tests", "Acmp.Web (vitest)"], "mutation_evidence": "handler no-op guard (compiling mutant, kills 2); reachability (compiling mutant, turns Architecture suite red); SPA pre-accept gate and role gate (mutants refused by tsc TS6133 AND kill a test each); source carry and current-type exclusion (compiling mutants, one test each)."}
